Command.Name: ReadVATrates
Command.FPOperation: Provides information about the current VAT rates (the last value stored in FM).

Res.Name: VATrateA
Res.Desc: (VAT rate A) Up to 7 symbols for VATrates of VAT class A in format ##.##%
